sources: dossier=event-log.md ('Every work_started pairs with a work_completed appended at terminal application ... parked / await-async re-entry excluded', 2026-06-11 last-mile-stability); error-policy.md ('retry emits transient/retry/<attempt>/<class>', 2026-05-23 signal-taxonomy); code=lib/runtime/runner.go:203-229 (runApplyTerminal called every loop iteration, before the IsRetry() check at :218), runner_terminal.go:59-91
note: Dossier intent is a strict 1:1 pairing with only park/await-async excluded -- retry is not an excluded case, and retry is defined as a transient (non-terminal) signal, not a settle. Verified in code: the retry loop invokes runApplyTerminal (which wraps emitWorkCompleted) on every iteration including ones later classified as in-place retries, so N retries yield N+1 work_completed events sharing one dispatch_id. Story and dossier agree; the runtime over-emits -> fix-code, queue only.
